title: Beyond The Simulation
description: Grow a Lab Grown Brain that Connects Redstone Beyond the Distances, Dimensions, Worlds, Servers and Realities? (yes, connect redstone to real life)

## Guide:
Treated Flesh‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ Nutrient Fluid  
![Treated Flesh](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cade88fa0faa26dcd0d50836689246b9c27541d.png)![Nutrient Fluid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/343cb40729d5260f592817bf89cd21ba60376016.png)

Use Treated Flesh on Perfusion System to Start Growing a Brain Organoid  
![Use Treated Flesh on Perfusion System to Start Growing a Brain Organoid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acb5e6eb09fa5e09a6628d544da482d0141f77dd.png)  
Camera  
![Camera](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80c748f2ada188b4df764470b4a020ec54a9d152.png)  
Right Click Camera Item and Enter a Discord Webhook URL to Send Pictures Directly to Discord

Click on MRA block and Use UI to Choose Between HTTP , Websocket or MQTT
for HTTP and WEbsocket give it the Endpoint URL where it will GET/POST 
for MQTT give it a Unique Topic Name
